pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hotel and hostel hybrid on Venice’s Mestre mainland, near the railway station, with private family rooms, a guest kitchen and shared spaces.

Family and budget stay

Book a whole private family room and confirm its beds, occupancy and cot needs. Dormitory beds are separate products. The guest kitchen, laundry and common spaces can help with longer stays; check equipment, storage, charges and house rules.

This property is in Mestre on the mainland. Visits to Venice’s historic lagoon centre involve a train or bus connection, with separate transport tickets and schedules. Allow for the walk to the station, transfers, luggage and children. Compare the full private-room price, taxes, breakfast, parking, storage and cancellation terms for the actual dates.

Guest feedback

Families praise the station access, larger multi-bed rooms and helpful reception staff. Accounts also report train noise, limited towels, thin pillows, light curtains, luggage-storage charges and variable service or meal experiences. These are guest reports; confirm the exact room and included services. Scores are a dated snapshot from a relatively small sample.

Brand opening and conversion

MEININGER opened on 1 March 2023, as explicitly reported that day. The opening inventory was 112 rooms and 434 beds. These are opening-era figures, not guaranteed later availability.

The seven-storey building previously housed a hostel and was partially remodelled with a redesigned interior. The event is the MEININGER brand opening, rather than the building’s first use. No property-specific conversion investment was verified.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: refreshed Tripadvisor UK snapshot 64 reviews, overall 3.8/5. Rooms 4.2, Service 4.3, Location 4.7, Cleanliness 4.4, Value 4.4, rounded to half steps. fabiola antico firsthand family review published 8 November with November 2026 context, site-translated from Italian. Towels, pillows, curtains, train noise, storage charges and variable service concerns retained; small sample explicit. MICHELIN complete Venezia, Italy list 1–33 of 33 and Forbes Venice, Italy have no MEININGER match; AAA awards exclude Italy. Acclaim zero records checked-guide absence. The separate MICHELIN Venice, California results were rejected.

pin.longFormSummary:
A family resort at Grand Mound near Centralia, Washington, with suites, indoor water-park access included in overnight stays and additional paid attractions.

Family water-park stay

Choose the exact suite layout, beds and booked occupancy; standard, themed and larger suites have different limits. Overnight water-park access and daily family activities are included. Confirm operating hours, height restrictions, wristbands, supervision and arrival-day or departure-day admission.

Paid attractions, arcade games, dining, parking and other extras can add to the bill. Compare full stay costs and package terms for your actual dates. The lodge is at Grand Mound on the Chehalis Reservation, rather than in central Seattle or Portland; allow for actual driving distances.

Guest feedback and recognition

Families describe children enjoying the water park and helpful staff. Accounts also raise crowded pools and limited seating, slow check-in, mismatches between booked and assigned rooms, cleaning concerns and extra costs. These are guest reports; confirm the exact suite, included package items and full bill. Scores are a dated snapshot.

AAA lists the exact Centralia-address property as Three Diamond. Its family-oriented resort description is separate from guest aggregate ratings; check the booked suite’s particular features.

Formal opening and resort development

The formal grand opening was held on 24 April 2008, according to the construction retrospective. This is distinct from earlier guest operations in March.

The current operator profile lists 407 suites after a refurbishment and the addition of nine suites in 2023. Earlier opening-era counts and water-park-area figures vary by source and are not combined into current inventory.

KNKX’s 2012 reporting describes US$170 million in resort construction investment. This is the reported whole-resort build cost, separate from early project budgets, later renovation spending and nightly room prices.
